## Appearance

Diana Barry is a notable beauty characterized by her black eyes, rosy crimson cheeks, and signature dimples. She has glossy, jet-black curls and a plump, dimpled hand.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Diana is a practical, smart, and notably ladylike individual who shows an unselfish admiration for the talents of her friends. She is skilled in singing, particularly capable of performing solos, and possesses a well-regarded taste in dress. Additionally, she is able to make excellent lettuce salad.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born. After meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), the two quickly formed a deep bond, solemnly swearing eternal friendship in the garden. When Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) temporarily forbade Diana from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), a devastated Diana had to keep her distance until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully saved her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from a severe case of croup during a winter night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring their friendship. Later, Diana helped form a story club with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), participated alongside her in a school flag concert, and brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a gift of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) passed the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island), Diana enthusiastically delivered the news to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As they grew older, Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spent their time exploring nature, canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), hostessing distinguished visitors, and seeking out unique Willow-ware platters. Their lives began to diverge when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) left for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while Diana remained in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md). Diana eventually married [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assisting in the preparations and recalling their childhood vows. Later, Diana gave birth to a child, whom [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited at their home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), +65 more_

## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> “Everything went off very well,” said Diana practically. “I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became fast friends immediately upon meeting in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), solemnly swearing an eternal friendship. They shared childhood milestones, went to school together, founded a story club, and later served on the committee for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Diana frequently accompanied and assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during major life events, such as preparing for her performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) concert.
